description: This bar chart, titled "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," illustrates the mean effect values for various multilingual BERT models—specifically mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across different language families and isolates. The horizontal axis categorizes the languages into groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language group contains a set of six colored bars, each representing one of the six models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The height of each bar indicates the mean effect value for that model on that language group, with error bars extending vertically to represent the standard deviation. For example, in the IE-Indic group, the tallest bar is mBERT-R₂ (light green) with an effect value of approximately 20, followed closely by XLM-R₂ (dark green) at about 18, and mBERT-B₂ (light pink) at about 19. In contrast, for the IE-Baltic group, all bars are relatively short, with values below 5. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the language families as listed on the x-axis. The chart visually emphasizes the performance differences across models and language families through the varying heights and colors of the bars.
